name: http-tail-collector
description: audit-log collector (warren-a0ff): out-of-core consumers of warren's HTTP API should use bounded ?since&limit event pages (implies follow=false, closes after page) rather than follow=1 fan-out; cursor per run keyed on burrowEventSeq (per-run monotonic, not global); checkpoint only after sink.apply for at-least-once; mark terminal runs drained locally since the wire never states stream completeness.

name: audit-log-export-surface
description: audit-log step 4: export surface lives in extensions/audit-log/src/server.ts; createFetchHandler is exported separately from createExportServer so tests skip sockets. healthz lag is derived (tracked vs undrained runs, last-cycle stats) because true lag is unknowable without a global stream. Retention prunes oldest-first; README documents the since-cursor gap semantics.
